name: Haus Haas Maria
beschreibung:
Quietly situated in Neustift, Haus Haas Maria welcomes guests with comfortable rooms and personal attention. It provides a peaceful base for holidays amidst alpine pastures and glacier peaks.

The Elfer ski lifts, the Schlick 2000 resort, and the Stubai Glacier are within easy reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Haas Maria in Neustift im Stubaital offers warm family hospitality and comfort in the heart of Tyrol.
